note: Authored for issue #2686 by hand from result-frames-summary.json: one row per (model, lineage_epoch). The lead result frame sits at epoch 1 (one init before it); the progress_note row sits at its seq (6) under progress_note:, and each summary pass sits at its OWN seq (7 intent, 8 plan, 11 and 14 the two pr_description passes) under the model prefix summary_pass:, so no pass collapses into the lead's haiku row of the same leg, into the note, or into another pass. The two pr_description rows are two rows that sum (a regeneration is real spend). Costs are the standard-table price (haiku: $1/M input, $5/M output, $0.10/M cache read): 1200*1e-6 + 150*5e-6 = 0.00195; 2000*1e-6 + 300*5e-6 + 10000*1e-7 = 0.0045; 3000*1e-6 + 500*5e-6 = 0.0055; 3500*1e-6 + 700*5e-6 + 4000*1e-7 = 0.0074. totals = SUM over rows per column.
